settings.customCharacterStyle: Exact canonical brothers from CHARACTER_SHEETS. Never alter faces, skin, hair, outfits, props, age or height relationship.
settings.customProjectStructure: 16 continuous pirate-island scenes. Map pieces, boat, bridge, treasure chest and key state persist. Scene N+1 starts from Scene N end frame. One speaker maximum.

movie.storyTitle: Roblox Brothers Adventure EP09 — โจรสลัดแห่งเกาะสมบัติ
movie.storySummary: สองพี่น้องเดินทางด้วยเรือลำเล็กไปเกาะสมบัติ ตามแผนที่สามส่วน ข้ามสะพานไม้ แก้กลไกถ้ำ และใช้กุญแจเปิดหีบ ก่อนนำสมบัติเพียงเหรียญที่ระลึกกลับออกจากเกาะอย่างปลอดภัย
movie.mainStoryPrompt: One continuous pirate-island treasure hunt. Exact brother identities fixed. Boat, map pieces, bridge state, key and chest state persist without reset.

scenes.title: เรือสู่เกาะ
scenes.continuityStartState: Canonical brothers sit in one small blocky boat approaching a tropical island; older at tiller, younger front-right.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother points at island dock

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ถึงเกาะแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: HARD IDENTITY LOCK. Same canonical brothers in same small boat, island dock ahead, no pirate branding text.
scenes.videoPrompt: Character Sheets primary. Side tracking with boat. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Boat reaches dock; older still at tiller, younger ready to step out; boat tied beside dock.

scenes.title: แผนที่ชิ้นแรก
scenes.continuityStartState: Boat tied at dock; both brothers beside it after disembarking.
scenes.mainAction: older brother finds first plain map fragment under a crate

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: เจอแผนที่ชิ้นหนึ่ง

scenes.imageDescription: Previous scene + Character Sheets. Same tied boat behind. One map fragment in older brother hand, no readable text.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium pickup shot. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Older carries first map fragment; younger stands beside him; footprints lead inland toward palms.

scenes.title: ตามรอยบนทราย
scenes.continuityStartState: Older carries first map fragment; footprints lead inland.
scenes.mainAction: brothers follow footprints toward wooden bridge

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: รอยไปทางสะพาน

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers walking inland; older still carries first map fragment; one wooden bridge ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low tracking along footprints then up to bridge. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both stop before bridge; first map fragment still with older; one loose plank visible near bridge entrance.

scenes.title: สะพานไม้หลวม
scenes.continuityStartState: Both before bridge; one loose plank at entrance; older holds map fragment.
scenes.mainAction: older brother places loose plank into missing slot

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ซ่อมก่อนค่อยข้าม

scenes.imageDescription: Same bridge state. Older inserts one loose plank; younger waits. Map fragment remains in older backpack/hand continuity.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close repair action. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Bridge entry repaired; plank fixed; both stand ready to cross; map fragment retained.

scenes.title: ข้ามสะพาน
scenes.continuityStartState: Bridge repaired; both ready at entrance.
scenes.mainAction: younger crosses first while older follows one step behind
scenes.imageDescription: Same repaired bridge, younger leading, older following, no reset or missing plank.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow across bridge. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both reach far side; bridge intact behind; stone marker and second map fragment visible ahead.

scenes.title: แผนที่ชิ้นสอง
scenes.continuityStartState: Both beyond bridge; second map fragment at stone marker; older has first fragment.
scenes.mainAction: younger picks up second fragment and compares edges

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ต่อกันได้พอดี

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers. Younger carries second fragment; older first; fragments visually compatible, no readable text.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close two-fragment comparison. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Two fragments held separately by brothers; cave entrance appears beyond vines.

scenes.title: เข้าถ้ำ
scenes.continuityStartState: Both hold one map fragment each; cave entrance ahead.
scenes.mainAction: they enter cave together and stop at floor-switch puzzle

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: อยู่ใกล้กันไว้

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers enter one cave; both map fragments remain carried; floor switches ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow into cave. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both stand before three plain floor switches; map fragments still carried; stone door closed beyond.

scenes.title: สวิตช์ถ้ำ
scenes.continuityStartState: Three switches before closed stone door; map fragments carried.
scenes.mainAction: younger notices shell symbols order and points first two switches

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ซ้าย กลาง แล้วขวา

scenes.imageDescription: Same switch layout; symbols only, no text. Brothers remain together with map fragments.
scenes.videoPrompt: Top-down tilt across switches. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Sequence identified; older foot poised over left switch, younger beside middle.

scenes.title: เปิดประตูหิน
scenes.mainAction: brothers activate switches in correct order and stone door opens

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ถูกแล้ว เปิดแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same three switches activate in order; stone door opens once; map fragments persist.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close stepping sequence then pan to door. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Stone door fully open; third map fragment and small brass key visible in chamber beyond.

scenes.title: แผนที่ครบ
scenes.continuityStartState: Door open; third fragment and brass key visible.
scenes.mainAction: older takes brass key while younger takes third map fragment

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: แผนที่ครบแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same chamber. Older now holds one brass key plus first fragment; younger holds second plus third fragment.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium two-shot pickup. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: All three map pieces gathered, brass key with older; chest chamber path revealed ahead.

scenes.title: ต่อแผนที่
scenes.continuityStartState: Three map pieces gathered; brass key with older; chest ahead.
scenes.mainAction: brothers place three map pieces together on stone table

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: จุดสมบัติอยู่ตรงนี้

scenes.imageDescription: Same three physical map pieces now assembled on table; brass key remains with older.
scenes.videoPrompt: Overhead map assembly then small tilt to chest. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Three-piece map remains assembled on table; locked chest directly ahead; older still holds brass key.

scenes.title: เปิดหีบ
scenes.continuityStartState: Map assembled on table; chest locked; older holds brass key.
scenes.mainAction: older inserts key and opens chest once

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: เปิดได้แล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same chest. Brass key moves into lock; chest opens; map remains assembled behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close key-turn and chest lid opening. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Chest open; one plain golden commemorative coin visible; key remains in lock; map still assembled.

scenes.title: เลือกของที่ระลึก
scenes.continuityStartState: Chest open with one commemorative coin; map assembled; key in lock.
scenes.mainAction: younger picks up only the single coin

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: เอาแค่นี้พอ

scenes.imageDescription: Same open chest becomes empty after one coin pickup. No extra treasure appears.
scenes.videoPrompt: Gentle close pickup. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Younger holds one coin; chest empty and open; return portal begins glowing at cave exit.

scenes.title: กลับออกจากถ้ำ
scenes.continuityStartState: Younger holds one coin; chest empty behind; return portal glow at cave exit.
scenes.mainAction: brothers walk back through already-open stone door toward exit

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: กลับเรือกัน

scenes.imageDescription: Door remains open from earlier; younger still holds coin; no map pieces carried because left assembled on table.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow through open door. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both emerge from cave; repaired bridge and dock route visible ahead; younger still holds coin.

scenes.title: กลับถึงท่าเรือ
scenes.continuityStartState: Brothers outside cave, younger with coin, route back intact.
scenes.mainAction: they return to same tied boat at dock

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: เรือยังอยู่

scenes.imageDescription: Same original boat tied in same orientation; brothers arrive with one coin only.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear track to dock. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Older at tiller seat, younger passenger seat holding coin; boat untied and ready to leave.

scenes.title: ออกจากเกาะ
scenes.continuityStartState: Both in original seats; boat untied; younger holds one coin.
scenes.mainAction: older pilots boat away while younger looks back at island

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ภารกิจสมบัติสำเร็จ

scenes.imageDescription: Same boat leaves island, same seating, younger still holds one coin, no extra treasure.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side tracking away from dock. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Boat moves safely away from island; brothers and single coin remain consistent; episode complete.
